svg.text: BQ25798EVM in place of the Ag105: wiring (board rev 20260622, round 4 r7)
docs/charger_bq25798_wiring_design_2026-11-05.md sections A.2-A.8 are the netlist; this drawing must match them
C-D6 pad 1 -> R170 10.0k -> T1; pad 2 -> T7b (shield)
r2: no current limit in Run
SNS-BT INA253 (55.1, 23.6 mm): GND/REF1 pad -> T9
CHG footprint (Ag105 holes) -> carrier CR header pins
pins 1-10 at board x 46.0 mm (input side); 11-22 at x 21.0 mm (battery side); table A.8
Teensy 4.1 breakout J1 / J2 (female, two positions per pin)
pin 7 CHG_CE_RB (in, far end; ROS removed)
CO-5V pad 1 (+5 V) -> F101 fuse + R172 33R at the joint -> T18, keep-alive option only (DNP).
T1/T2: 10.0k at the joint, then the wire.
Pins 5, 6, 18, 19 reach CR through CHG pads 11, 3, 8, 7 (no tap). Pin 20 kept for WDOG1_B (R5).
Pins 2, 8 (encoder nets) untouched (T-A-01b); F24 optional PURGE_SENSE on pin 2 only if cleared. No T7.
EVM on its stock bumpons, held by edge clamps;
EIB on its two M3 nylon standoffs (EVM and EIB on one plate)
CR r7: r6 footprint + tab X + tab Y, FT1/FT2
1x10 + 1x12 header pins = CHG pads (A.2); netlist B.8
OUT: D103 SMA + C103 (r5 region table)
MODE open, SHDN open, PGTH + PGOOD to GND
U102 H1: V-MOT (T1) vs VBUS (T2C), ratio 1.089
U103 UVB: VBUS > 13.33 / 13.72 V (same T2 wire)
U104 BT_OK: BT-CURR (T8) < 19.75 mV, Kelvin T9 + R143
U119 FCC_OFF (T5 < REF/3); U120 FCC_ON, U121 RGN_ON (> 1.75 V)
readbacks: H1 -> T13, H2c -> T14, BT_OK -> T15
H1q = H1 . RGN_ON . FCC_OFF . UVB; H1R = H1 . RGN_ON (U118A)
H2c = FCC_ON . BTB_OFF . BT_OK . FCI_OK . ((UVB . FCCEIL) + H1R)
QQ = U111 one-shot (QUAL, CLR = P5N); QQF = QQ . FCC_OFF
ARM_OK' = ARM_OK (U113, 20-46 ms) . OVN (BQ29200 via U123, r6)
ILIM_REL = (GATE + QQF) . ARM_OK' -> W5 pins 7 and 8
inputs: FCC F06 (U119/U120), RGN F05 (U121), BTB F04, BAL F08,
QUAL F11, FCCEIL F12, HB F21, CHG_ARM (P5) pad 11
-> VCHG (pads 18/19). Fit only if T-B-09 fails
J101 2x7 1.27 mm SMT, keyed -> W5 ribbon to EIB J201
tap field: 6 x 4 grid on tab X + residual pads F08-F10, F22 (A.7 r7)
SCL/SDA/GND pads -> W7 to EVM J8; R145/R146 DNP
STAT pad 3: R107 10k to 3V3 -> W5 pin 4
THERM pad 13 -> W6 (only if NTC, T-E-09)
r7: Eagle coords, +y UP; chamfer at the tab Y -x/+y corner (17.70, 76.00), pin-11 side
r7: W leads on the A.3 dressing path (B1/B3, S1-S3, A1/A2)
1Y -> /CE (E5, TP36); R272 + R272b 47k on the EVM
R276 10.0R: E1 pad -> REGN node C205 (r7)
unpowered: /CE HIGH, Q201 on, Q203 off
W7 GND bonded at the CR only
EIB joints (A.5 row top->bottom, max mm)
E8 TP49 AGND 20; E3 TP33 ILIM 25
E2 JP14 pin 2 35; E7 TP38 STAT 40
E1 JP12 REGN pin 90 (R276 at EIB)
R42, R39, R40, JP32, JP7, JP30 out
JP14 shunt + pin 1, JP13 pin 1, R20 out
JP1/JP2 2-3; JP3/JP5 links in holes, JP4 shunt
J2 removed, J3/J4 insulated; JP24 kept
no capacitor added at the input
fixed 0.30 m +- 10 mm (D-F3); slack = service loop
<= 0.30 m until MS2; route maxima after MS2
<= 0.30 m until MS2; route maxima after MS2
W5 14-way 0.635 mm ribbon, fixed 0.30 m cable (J101 -> J201)
